{"id":1955681940,"question_id":4097,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"4 months","timestamp":1774178143,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1955681940/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Removals to Achieve Target XOR","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int dp[45][20000];\n    int byrec(vector<int>&nums , int target , int ans , int i)\n    {\n        if(i >= nums.size())\n        {\n            if(ans == target) return 0;\n            return -100000;\n        }\n\n        if(dp[i][ans] != -1) return dp[i][ans];\n\n        int take = 1 + byrec(nums , target , ans ^ nums[i] , i+1);\n        int not_take = 0 + byrec(nums , target , ans , i+1);\n\n        return dp[i][ans] = max(take , not_take);\n    }\n    \n    int minRemovals(vector<int>& nums, int target) {\n        memset(dp , -1 , sizeof(dp));\n        int opr = byrec(nums , target , 0 , 0);\n        cout<<opr<<endl;\n\n        if(opr <= 0) return -1;\n\n        return nums.size() - opr;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-removals-to-achieve-target-xor","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1853}
